Does neovim crash when opening the file or as you're typing something?

And have you tried reproducing with some text that does not have licensing restrictions? Reproducibility goes a long way in getting issues fixed.

Neovim crashes when I scroll to a specific portion of an open text file. 

I'm currently trying to track down the actual culprit, maybe there's some odd byte sequence that I overlooked. I'll try to make a file that reproduces the problem, then I'll post it here.

So far, it seems to have to do with vim-spell. The file in question begins with the following modelines:

```
.. vim:spell
.. vim:spelllang=en_us
```

If I disable vim-spell or change the language to something else (ex. `spelllang=de_ch`), both Vim and Neovim behave normally. However, the faulty behaviour reappears if I use any other English language dictionary (ex. `spelllang=en_gb`). I suspect that it's something to do with my `en.utf-8.add` file. Its newest entry contains an entire sentence on one line (probably accidentally added) instead of just a word. The issue goes away if I remove that entry from the dictionary and rebuild the `spl`file. It also works with other full sentences.

Attached files in [reproduction.zip](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/files/451863/reproduction.zip):
- en.utf-8.add
- en.utf-8.add.spl
- repro.rst

## Steps to reproduce using `nvim -u NORC`

`cp en.utf-8.add* ~/.config/nvim/spell/`
`nvim -u NORC repro.rst`
